candidates.title: Lead Us To Repentance • Official Lyric Video

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, where can we hide?
There's nothing hidden from your sight You know every heart You've
Seen the depths of who we are
But when our shame says run Your mercy calls us home
To repentance Make us know your presence Even when
We fall You are never far
Draw us with your kindness With you there's forgiveness Condemnation's gone
All the work is done Lead us to repentance

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: There's no greater love Our Savior bled and died for us
Guilty ones are trained
In Jesus' perfect righteousness So when we go astray Lord,
Give us grace to pray Lead us to repentance Make
Us know your presence Even when we fall You are
Draw us with your kindness With you there's forgiveness Come,
